lessons_used: Predictions continue to underpredict gains on winning tests while remaining overoptimistic for non-winning tests.
Sign-in hint (6 wins across 14 tests), home wait_info (3 wins across 10 tests), finish new_flow (2 wins across 8 tests), and adoption new_flow (2 wins across 4 tests) changes were helpful.
Sign-in reorder changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests.
Choose_path copy, home redesign, home new_screen, and adoption incentive changes showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Evidence remains thin for change types tested only once.

candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about missing or reset pets after sign-in. Sign-in hints have a high win rate (6/14 tests).
